tasks.task: Set total budget and agree the family-wise split
Discuss wedding style, cities and approximate guest count
Fix wedding date and muhurat with the pandit
Decide the list of functions and their dates
Make the first draft of the guest list (both sides)
Shortlist and visit venues
Book the main venue / hall and pay the advance
Hire a wedding planner / coordinator (get 3 quotes)
Block hotel rooms for outstation guests
Book photographer and videographer
Book the caterer and plan the menu tasting
Book the decorator and finalise the theme
Book makeup artist and mehndi artist
Start bridal lehenga and groom sherwani shopping
Book DJ, band and dhol
Hire sangeet choreographer; set the practice schedule
Design the save-the-date and invitation cards
Send save-the-date to outstation guests
Book honeymoon tickets and visas
Start jewellery shopping
Plan travel for key family members (trains / flights)
Check marriage registration requirements and documents
Finalise guest list v2 with phone numbers
Decide family outfit colours for each function
Meet the pandit and discuss the rituals for each function
Finalise the menu for each function with the caterer
Book transport: guest cars, buses, baraat vehicle
Order invitation cards / finalise the digital invite and video
Plan return gifts for guests
Plan the shagun and lena-dena list (family-wise)
Pay second instalments to venue, caterer and decorator
Shop the trousseau: sarees, suits and gifts for relatives
Send invitations (cards + WhatsApp e-invite)
Book bridal / groom suites and family rooms
Finalise decor design for each function
Finalise photo / video shot list and must-have family photos
Make the puja samagri list and order the items
Book mehndi, haldi and sangeet outfits
Order custom items: welcome hampers, signage, menu cards
Follow up on RSVPs (first round)
Allocate rooms to families (Room Allocation sheet)
Plan transport allocation and airport / station pickups
Finalise the music playlist and sangeet performances
Bridal makeup trial and hair trial
Draft the wedding-day run-sheet (Run Sheet tab)
Pay third instalments to vendors and collect receipts
Buy milni gifts and family gifting jewellery
First fitting: lehenga, sherwani and family outfits
Finalise baraat route, timing and permissions
Get all vendor contracts confirmed in writing
Second round of RSVP follow-ups; update the guest list
Plan seating / table layout for the main functions
Share the function schedule and dress codes with family
Arrange permits: music licence, fireworks, venue entry
Buy shagun envelopes, mithai boxes and return-gift packing
Get marriage registration papers ready (IDs, photos, affidavits)
Lock the guest count and give the estimate to the caterer
Confirm the rooming list with the hotel
Pack trousseau trunks and gift hampers
Final fittings and alterations
List every balance payment due and its date
Reconfirm all vendors: dates, timings, contact persons
Confirm pandit, samagri and muhurat timing for each ritual
Share transport and pickup details with guests
Prepare an emergency kit (medicines, safety pins, chargers, snacks)
Lock the final headcount with the caterer; share diet counts
Share the run-sheet with vendors, planner and family leads
Final rehearsal for sangeet performances
Assign a family helper for each function
Prepare final vendor payments due on or before the wedding
Reconfirm hotel check-in, rooms and welcome desks
Pack bags for the honeymoon and the first days after the wedding
Prepare shagun envelopes with names (len-den)
Reconfirm decor setup time, venue access and power backup
Confirm the photographer's shot list and family group photos
Hand over cash and envelopes to a trusted family member
Collect outfits, jewellery and trunks; check every item
Reconfirm drivers and vehicle numbers
Welcome hampers and room decor ready at the hotel
Bridal mehndi and a pre-wedding rest
Venue walkthrough: stage, seating, food counters, exits
Puja items and mandap material delivered and checked
Wedding day: follow the run-sheet; keep one helper with the bride
Collect final bills from vendors and sign the handover
Vidaai arrangements: car, rituals, tissues, snacks
Griha pravesh, welcome of the bride and post-wedding rituals
Return rented items, trunks and decor property
Settle all remaining vendor balances
Send thank-you messages to guests and vendors
Review the shagun register and plan returns (lena-dena)
Collect photos and videos; make a safe backup
Complete the marriage registration (if pending)
Review budget vs actual spend; note learnings

rituals.item: Roka thali: roli, chawal, mauli, kumkum
Mithai and dry-fruit boxes for exchange
Shagun envelopes for the couple and elders
Sagai thali with fruits and sweets
Haldi paste: turmeric, sandalwood, rose water
Yellow outfits / old clothes and aprons
Towels and a change of clothes for the couple
Extra mehndi cones and artists' time slots
Seating and cushions for mehndi guests
Bride's design reference photos for the artist
Ghodi / horse booking and groom's sehra, safa
Aarti thali, tilak and welcome drinks
Mandap, havan kund and seating for elders
Havan samagri: ghee, samidha, til, jau, kapoor
Kalash with mango leaves and coconut
Fruits, dry fruits, mithai and prasad
Entry theme, music and photographer briefing
Return gifts ready at the exit
Flower petals, tissues, snacks for the couple
Elder blessing and family photo plan

runsheet.activity: Bride: wake-up, haldi wash, start makeup
Vendors on site: decor, sound, caterer setup
Baraat assembly at the hotel entrance

shopping.item: Suit pieces for groom's side relatives
